title: Nothing is drawn after the last conversation
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeData and open the Inbox
Press Cmd-Down (or drag the scroll bar to the bottom)
Scroll quickly up and down a few times, then stop
expected: The last conversation is the last row: no grey bars or empty plates below it. Rows that load at once never flash a skeleton; a soft skeleton shows only for rows that take longer than a moment, and none after a failed read (the Retry bar shows instead).
